description: A completed item's $ condition fails before its tag query runs. That query would fail on an empty split delimiter, but the result is rejection (engine §4, §10).
grammar:
%rule text (A x)
%rule x B :: $.tokens-after-first.tags(migration-fault) %conditions $.source-text = "q"

%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
